svg.title: A narrow strip
svg.desc: The large photograph shows lappet 1979.310.13a. Below it, 13a and the separately recorded 13b appear as equal-size thumbnails stacked vertically with accession labels. The museum documents the pair; this page shows them in sequence and does not assert their placement on a cap.
svg.text: I took the flowered strip for a sample,
A second lappet has its own record.
Lappets hung from lace caps at the sides or back.
Needle lace, point d'Argentan, linen | 22 x 4 inches
